title: 编码器读头板：光电流到正余弦信号
title_en: Encoder read-head board: photocurrent to sine/cosine
summary: 传感器厂的光电编码器要一块读头板：把几微安的光电流放大成 1 Vpp 的正余弦信号。算跨阻、带宽，ngspice 核对；把幅值、偏置、相位误差换算成细分误差（角秒），蒙特卡洛看 1 % 电阻和光电管不对称留下多少偏置；电路板厂做 50 块、功能测试四项。
summary_en: The optical encoder of the sensor plant needs a read-head board turning a few microamps of photocurrent into 1 Vpp sine/cosine signals: transimpedance and bandwidth calculated and checked in ngspice; amplitude, offset and phase errors converted to interpolation error in arc-seconds; Monte Carlo for the offset left by 1 % resistors and photodiode mismatch; 20 boards built and tested on four items.
honest: 示例设计：经计算和仿真校核，没有实物试制；数值为示例值。
honest_en: Example design: checked by calculation and simulation, not built and tested; all values are examples.

steps.title: 任务书
steps.summary: 2048 线（一周期 633″）；输出 1 Vpp、偏置 ±20 mV、相位 90±3°、细分误差 ≤ 40″；最高 2.0 kHz。
steps.summary_en: 2048 lines (633″ per period); 1 Vpp, ±20 mV offset, 90±3° phase, ≤ 40″ interpolation error; up to 2.0 kHz.

tools.label: 编码器误差曲线（传感器厂）

steps.title: 方案
steps.summary: 正反相两个光电管各一级跨阻放大再相减：直流抵消、交流加倍；跨阻 100 kΩ、10 pF（零件库）。
steps.summary_en: A transimpedance stage for each of the two antiphase photodiodes, then subtract: DC cancels, AC doubles; 100 kΩ and 10 pF from the library.

steps.title: 计算
steps.summary: 差分 1.00 Vpp、带宽 159 kHz（2.0 kHz 时掉 0.008 %）；读头板公差全取上限，细分误差 10.1″（≤ 40″）。
steps.summary_en: 1.00 Vpp differential, 159 kHz bandwidth (0.008 % drop at 2.0 kHz); with every board tolerance at its limit, interpolation error 10.1″ (≤ 40″).

tools.label: 编码器误差曲线（传感器厂）

steps.title: 仿真
steps.summary: ngspice 幅值、带宽与公式一致；1 % 电阻 + 光电管 2 % 让偏置标准差 11 mV、8 % 超差——偏置必须出厂调。
steps.summary_en: ngspice amplitude and bandwidth match the formulas; 1 % resistors and 2 % photodiodes give 11 mV offset spread, 8 % out of tolerance — offset trimming at test is required.

figs.caption: 频响、偏置蒙特卡洛、李萨如图
figs.caption_en: Frequency response, offset Monte Carlo, Lissajous

steps.title: 三维与图纸
steps.summary: 框图、零件库元件、四条布局要点（保护环、对称、电源远离、清洗）；读头板 KiCad 工程以后补。
steps.summary_en: Block diagram, library parts and four layout rules (guard ring, symmetry, supply far away, cleaning); the KiCad project of this board is to follow.

steps.title: 工艺
steps.summary: 贴片 + 后段；湿敏的光电读头、涂覆遮蔽光学窗口、功能测试先调偏置再测。
steps.summary_en: SMT + back end; moisture-sensitive optical sensor, mask the optical window during coating, trim the offset before functional test.

steps.title: 制造
steps.summary: 50 块功能测试四项，不合格 0，最低 Cpk 1.42；细分误差均值 15″。
steps.summary_en: 50 boards, four functional tests, 0 failures, lowest Cpk 1.42; mean interpolation error 15″.

steps.title: 总结
steps.summary: 5 / 5 项校核通过；1.0 Vpp、带宽 159 kHz、最坏细分误差 10.1″。
steps.summary_en: 5 / 5 checks pass; 1.0 Vpp, 159 kHz, worst-case interpolation error 10.1″.
